title: Spectrum Annual of Fantastic Art
content: The 15th Spectrum Annual is now available in bookstores and online retailers. This collection of the imaginative artwork features artwork from all over the world and includes a new concept art category.The jury included Justin Sweet, Daren Bader, Frank Cho, Tim Bodendistel and Kelley Seda (photo by Arlo Burnett). Directors Cathy and Arnie Fenner say that the hardcover version, which will be distributed to accepted artists was held up a little bit in customs, but should arrive within a month or so.More information about Spectrum, along with application forms for next year’s competition (Deadline January 23, 2009), can be found at the official Spectrum Website: http://www.spectrumfantasticart.com/about.php
